role: Generate the inline <script> body for the attached index.html (a Zone01 slide-deck template). Read the instructions comment at the top of index.html for the full API (addContent/addQuiz/addFillBlank/addMatching) and available CSS classes — do not assume anything beyond what that comment states.
output: Only the sequence of add*() calls ending with initSlideDeck(). No markdown fences, no extra prose.
exact_syntax: addContent(`...raw HTML...`); addQuiz([{q:"...",options:["a","b","c","d"],correct:0,explain:"..."}, ...]); addFillBlank([{code:"...__id__...",blanks:[{id:"id",answer:"..."}],explain:"..."}], {note:"..."}); addMatching([{term:"...",def:"..."}, ...], {note:"..."}) — use backticks exactly as shown for addContent's HTML string, real JS array/object literals for the rest.
code_blocks:
For colored code inside addContent(): 
...
(or lang-js / lang-html / lang-css) — highlighter.js colors it automatically, do not add manual tags. Since the code sits inside HTML, escape < > & as < > & in the code text (this applies inside addFillBlank's `code` string too, around the plain-text parts, not around the __id__ markers themselves).
structure: 1 title slide (keep the existing title-slide markup/callout as scaffolded)
theory sections, full depth, self-contained code examples
interleave addQuiz() checkpoints regularly, not only at the end
a short glossary addContent() may appear after any section/quiz where useful, not only once at the end
at least one addFillBlank() and one addMatching() somewhere reasonable
one final combined addQuiz() with several questions
one consolidated glossary + one sources/footer addContent() at the end (keep the 'pavgerin/avgerinos8' credit)
quiz_rules: 4 options, similar length/style, no option stands out by size
at least one distractor per deck ~5 words longer than the correct answer
one short explanation per question after reveal
hard_constraints: never solve the actual exercise/assignment — theory and tools only
confirm the section list with the user before generating full content, unless already confirmed
response_format: If replying with a full file, attach/output the complete file as-is. If replying as plain chat text, wrap the ENTIRE code output in five backticks on their own line before and after (````` ... `````) so it can be copy-pasted as one block.
